messages:
jon (DevEx): Heads up — new user hit our Node quickstart and the sample app fails on first API call with HTTP 402 / {"error":"billing_not_enabled"}. They followed the exact README.

jon (DevEx): Node snippet they ran: ```js
const rwd = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new rwd.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RWD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'hi' });
console.log(res);
```

priya (Support): Is this a fresh workspace created via SSO or standard sign-up? 402 typically means billing hasn't been turned on for the workspace account-level.

jon (DevEx): It was created by an org admin via SSO. Console shows a card added but the workspace banner says "Billing setup pending". No explicit TOS accept step shown in quickstart. User assumed adding card was enough.

marc (SDK): SDK should bubble the API error as-is. Do we have analytics on how many first-call failures are due to billing gating?

priya (Support): I saw a spike last week — lots of "first call fails" tickets after we changed the SSO flow. The onboarding flow now requires an additional accept-TOS confirmation for org-admins, but quickstart doesn't surface that requirement.

tina (Accounts): Workflow: SSO org admin creates workspace -> add payment method -> must click "Accept billing terms" in Console (we added the banner to avoid accidental charges). If they don't click, transactions are blocked.

jon (DevEx): Could we tweak quickstart to show a screenshot callout: "If workspace created via SSO, ensure admin accepts Billing Terms in Console"? Also maybe add a clearer error mapping in SDK when status code 402 or code billing_not_enabled — provide next action.

marc (SDK): We can map 402/billing_not_enabled to a friendlier message in JS/Go SDKs and include a link to the Console billing page. I'll open PR to add message: "Billing not enabled for workspace. Have admin accept billing terms in Console or retry after activation. Read: https://console.redwood.ai/billing"

onboarding-bot: Note created: quickstart-billing-note (internal).

priya (Support): Short-term support reply: "If you're an end user, ask your org admin to Accept Billing Terms in Console -> Billing. If you're the admin, refresh the workspace or click the banner. After activation, retry the call." I'll paste the exact console screenshot.

tina (Accounts): We can remove the extra click for small orgs but don't want accidental charges. For now, UX note plus SDK mapping is fine.

marc (SDK): Also adding an exponential backoff in the CLI quickstart command when it detects a workspace in pending billing state — retry 5 times with 3s intervals. PR #3582.

jon (DevEx): I'll update quickstart README and the sample app readme to show the admin step and include the exact error that users might see, so they know it's billing gating and not a broken SDK.

onboarding-bot: Deploy scheduled: v1.35.0 -> staging.

priya (Support): I'll follow up with the reporter once docs + SDK PRs land. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
